versions.changelog:
Initial release of "ym-doc-version-diff" (文档版本变更核对):

- Compares two versions of a document, highlighting all insertions, deletions, modifications, and position moves.
- Distinguishes between substantive changes (e.g., numbers, dates, money, scope, obligations) and cosmetic or formatting changes.
- Marks high-risk modifications (e.g., involving amounts, dates, parties, penalties, exclusivity, terms) for extra review.
- Provides clear "old value → new value" comparison for each substantive change.
- Handles structural changes (e.g., section reorder) and very large documents by section-based comparison.
- Outputs a detailed Markdown report with all differences categorized for quick review.
